title: Premier Money Market Levels and the Level of the Personal Checking Closing Charge
content:
**Clause.** The level at which the closing charge on a Personal Checking account is set moves with the owner's premier money market balance held under Savings & Money Market Accounts, with how long the account has been open, and with the owner's card payments under Personal Credit Cards.

1. Where the owner's premier money market balance reaches the tier's relationship maintenance threshold **and** the account has been open at least as long as the settled account period of 60 days, the closing charge is set at the tier's early closure charge less a relationship charge relief of 6.5.
2. Where the case above does not apply **and** either the owner's premier money market balance reaches the protection source minimum of 5000.00 **or** the owner has made at least 8 card payments in the last twelve months, the closing charge is set at the tier's early closure charge less a modest charge relief of 3.0.
3. Where neither case applies, no such relief is given and the charge stands at the tier's own figure.

The tier's early closure charge and relationship maintenance threshold are the tier's own figures:

| Tier | Early closure charge (USD) |
|---|---|
| Access Checking | 0.00 |
| Student Checking | 0.00 |
| Everyday Checking | 25.00 |
| Interest Checking | 25.00 |
| Premier Checking | 25.00 |
| Private Client Checking | 25.00 |

| Tier | Relationship maintenance threshold (USD) |
|---|---|
| Access Checking | not offered |
| Student Checking | not offered |
| Everyday Checking | 5000.00 |
| Interest Checking | 15000.00 |
| Premier Checking | 25000.00 |
| Private Client Checking | 250000.00 |

**Worked levels on hypothetical inputs.** On a tier whose early closure charge is 25.00:

| Owner's position | Closing charge level |
|---|---|
| Premier money market balance at or above the tier's threshold, account open 400 days | 18.50 |
| Premier money market balance at or above the tier's threshold, account open 45 days | 22.00, only the second case being reached through the premier money market limb |
| Premier money market balance of 900.00, 11 card payments in the last twelve months | 22.00 |
| Premier money market balance of 900.00, 2 card payments | 25.00 |

The first case requires both of its limbs; the second is met by either limb alone. Equality satisfies each threshold, so an account open exactly 60 days with a qualifying premier money market balance reaches the first case.
